piezas.titulo: Grammar in context: Schedules, appointments and weekly routine
texto: Sentence structure for times and parts of the day in Thai: to fix a time, «ตอน» (at the moment of) or «เวลา» is used, followed by the time: «ตอนบ่ายสามโมง» (at three in the afternoon). Future pattern: [Time] + [Subject] + «จะ» + [Verb]: «พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะไปพบหมอ». Pattern for a completed action or result: [Subject] + [Verb] + «เสร็จแล้ว» (to have finished...): «ฉันทำงานเสร็จแล้ว». Notice how «จะ» comes before the main verb, while «แล้ว» comes at the end of the predicate.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การมาตรงตามเวลานัดหมายสะท้อนถึงความรับผิดชอบและความเคารพต่อผู้อื่น» express?

opciones.texto: Arriving punctually for an appointment shows responsibility and respect for others.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การมาตรงตามเวลานัดหมายสะท้อนถึงความรับผิดชอบและความเคารพต่อผู้อื่น» from the text.

opciones.texto: Giving notice of a postponement in good time lets you reorganise the day.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The early afternoon is ideal for follow-up meetings.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: What is the difference in syntactic position between the future particle «จะ» and the completed-action particle «แล้ว»?

opciones.texto: «จะ» goes before the verb and «แล้ว» goes after the verb or at the end
opciones.explicacion: Correct: «จะ» is pre-verbal (prospective aspect) and «แล้ว» is post-verbal or final (completive aspect).

opciones.texto: Both are placed only at the beginning of the sentence
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: neither of them starts a sentence on its own as a time particle.

opciones.texto: «แล้ว» goes before the subject and «จะ» at the end
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: that placement completely reverses Thai grammar.
